name: Morpho Reverie
source:
Morpho Reverie is set in the year 2040. During a music audition, contestant Keeva suddenly vanishes—replaced by an AI replica known as Keeva-α. As Rein, the protagonist, you must compose music for the other contestants to help them defeat their own AI replicas, all while searching for the truth behind Keeva's disappearance.

[Taken from Steam]
